decision.title: More streamed shapes: streamed paths and aggregates (packet 7.6c)
decision.summary: Streamed bodies of xsl:source-document also accept a in a consuming instruction's select, aggregates folded node by node, and xsl:apply-templates into a streamable mode as stream points.

body.p: , after , , , . Extends 's streamed bodies of xsl:source-document streamable="yes"; the rest of stands.

item.p: Streamed paths (glossary ): a downward path ('s steps, perhaps a last attribute step: "E/@a" is "E ! @a" in a shallow window) inside the select of xsl:value-of, xsl:copy-of, xsl:sequence, xsl:for-each, xsl:apply-templates, xsl:iterate or xsl:for-each-group of a streamed body is a stream point when the instruction is consuming and grounded by 7.6a's sweep (19.8.1, 19.8.4) and the rest of the select is motionless around the path (operators, conditionals, function calls; a simple map or filter on it reads its nodes). One per body, as before.

Lowering override (glossary , src/xpath_lower_internal.h): the XPath lowerer has a view of nodes a caller's procedure lowers instead of their kind's rule (also when a chain's spine walk meets them). The plan publishes one per streamed path; it is valid in any focus (a STREAM walks a tree when its origin is no open node), and a body whose path was not lowered by it is an internal error, not a wrong result.

Grounding (19.4): the node in a full window; fn:data of it for distinct-values, data, string-join, avg and multi-argument forms; for fn:count, fn:exists and fn:empty the chain's counter only (shallow windows, the call is the overridden node); for one-argument fn:sum, fn:min and fn:max a fold: the new IR field sxml_ir_stream.fold, a slot the body's value F((fold, fn:data(.))) is bound to after each node, the STREAM's own value empty, F(fold) read after the chain (F&O 4.0, 14.4: each is the fold of its pairwise form). STREAM's counter and fold LETs are rebound by the evaluator: IR passes must not move them (the hoist pass of moves LETs of MAP and FILTER bodies only).

Template rules node by node: an xsl:apply-templates with a path select (no xsl:sort or separator), motionless xsl:with-param, whose mode names one mode declared streamable whose every template rule is guaranteed-streamable (new sxml_xslt_assess_mode, 6.6.4) and reads no fn:last, fn:path, fn:has-children, call-template or attribute set, is a stream point: each node's full window gets the templates as it passes, with its position in the path. New IR field sxml_ir_apply_templates.focus: with select NONE, the item and position of a STREAM's focus, no size. Other apply-templates of a streamable mode over a streamed path apply them to the full windows of the selection.

Accumulators: declared accumulators no longer stop streaming when the document's use-accumulators names none and no expression calls fn:accumulator-before or -after. Streamed accumulator values are not done.
Fixed (): a text, comment or processing instruction queued before a following start tag was read at the depth after it, losing text after an empty child element.

Not done: accumulators computed while streaming, xsl:fork, xsl:merge, a streamed principal source (no xslt.h field yet, so no record), template rules streamed with shallow windows (their own stream points), the IR printer's fold and focus (src/ir.c had another packet's change), incremental tokenizing ('s segments now bound the parser).

Measured (release driver, whole XT40, same HEAD with and without): xsl:source-document executions that stream 164 to 986 (no case changed: 11,827 at 623bf87, 11,826 at 4589ec8); template rules applied node by node 0 to 57 nodes in 6 test sets (most XT40 template rules of streamable modes read fn:last or are applied to "."); folded aggregates over 600,075 nodes in sf-sum, sf-min, sf-max. Allocator peaks over a 2.4 MB generated document under a 1 MB limit (each unstreamed run exceeds it): count 186 KB, sum 223 KB, sum of attributes and max 213 KB, copy-of of a selection 232 KB, apply-templates over all 30,000 records 233 KB (tests/evaluator_stream_test.c).
